page: UpCloud GPU-32xCPU-384GB-3xL40S is a GPU-accelerated server configured with 32 vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9575F processor on the x86_64 architecture. The system features 32 physical cores with a single thread per core, running at a base speed of 2.0 GHz under a KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing 12.0 GB of RAM per core. The primary hardware highlight is the inclusion of three NVIDIA L40S GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, delivering a combined 144 GB of GPU VRAM. No local storage is bundled with this instance type.

Benchmark results place this server in the top tier for both single-core and multi-core CPU performance, with a stress-ng single-core score of 4190.38 and a multi-core score of 132459.57. Memory bandwidth is strong, registering 6377.89 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 331.99 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. The system also demonstrates top-tier capabilities in data decompression, with a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 564.29 GB/sec, and database operations, achieving 128.07 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks.

From a resource density perspective, this server offers high qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring massive parallel GPU compute and substantial system memory without the overhead of local storage. The combination of 144 GB of VRAM and 384 GB of system RAM makes it highly suitable for large-scale AI model training, deep learning inference, complex 3D rendering, and high-throughput data processing pipelines.
